description: STM32 Nucleo-64 development board, STM32F401RE MCU, on-board ST-LINK/V2-1
ESP32 ESP-WROOM-32 dev board, 30-pin, USB-C, CP2102
notes: Handheld node. Original ESP32 — Bluetooth Classic required for HC-05 link.

description: 9-axis IMU breakout, 16-bit accel + gyro + magnetometer, I2C/SPI
notes: Magnetometer (AK8963) is a separate die at its own I2C address — enable pass-through on the MPU to reach it. Yaw unused in v1. Verify WHO_AM_I at first bring-up.

description: Bluetooth Classic serial module with breakout and EN button
notes: Configure to master mode over AT, bind to H1.U1 address.

description: Digital servo, 20kg-cm, 270 deg travel — pan axis
notes: Part of pan-tilt mount. Confirm pulse width range in Yahboom docs.

description: Digital servo, 25kg-cm, 180 deg travel — tilt axis
notes: Part of pan-tilt mount. Mismatched travel vs pan — separate clamp per axis.

description: 2DOF aluminum pan-tilt bracket, M3 mounting, ~60.5mm U-bracket width
notes: Measure inner gap and hole spacing before mounting any end effector.
Servo supply only. Ground must tie to MC1.U1 ground.

description: Barrel jack to screw terminal adapter, 5.5x2.1mm
notes: Check current rating of existing adapter.

description: Silicone or solid-core hookup wire, 20-22 AWG, red and black
notes: Servo power run only. Solid core if it enters a breadboard.
